maintenance.reason: Alpha9.40 adds safe, opt-in Weekend Happy Hour planning and auto-join. KEMS evaluates eligible Octopus Weekend Happy Hour choices against the complete energy plan once day-ahead tariff coverage is sufficient, including the value of free import, later avoided import, solar/headroom effects and paid-export opportunity cost. No paid export never creates headroom through deliberate battery export. Automatic joining is disabled by default and can call the supported Octopus join service only in Control mode when the explicit auto-join switch, master control, commissioning, battery-installed and emergency-stop gates all permit it; Simulate mode remains read-only and reports what KEMS would choose. A successful KEMS booking is persisted and becomes authoritative Happy Hour dispatch evidence even when Octopus Energy 19.1 exposes the joined Power Up event with a code that the older generic classifier correctly rejects; ambiguous live Power Up evidence still wins fail-safe. Alpha9.40 does not grant any new FoxESS hardware-write authority, weaken commissioning/control safety gates, or alter the Alpha9.39 unified Live Data/KEMS simulation-authority contract. Alpha9.39 makes the customer Live Data and KEMS views share one metric contract while keeping their authorities strictly separate: Live Data remains measured/observed, and KEMS is now fully digital-twin simulated for the same current, daily-energy and cost fields. A ready current-day Full KEMS period is authoritative for SOC, cumulative energy and costs immediately after midnight even before the first settled half-hour, while final Full KEMS routing remains authoritative for instantaneous simulated power; the generic proposal replay is only a fallback when Full KEMS itself is not ready. This prevents mixed states such as stale 80.2% SOC and ~0.17 kWh cumulative import being displayed beside a canonical ~7.56 kW Full KEMS charge/import flow. Alpha9.39 is simulation presentation/accounting authority and dashboard parity only: no optimiser allocation, tariff policy, battery policy, commissioning authority, control eligibility or FoxESS hardware-write permission changes. Alpha9.38 corrects the one remaining ROI commissioning dashboard reference left by Alpha9.37 live proof. The House electricity row now maps sensor.kems_financial_house_consumption to the actually registered sensor.kems_house_electricity_since_commissioning instead of the nonexistent sensor.kems_house_consumption_since_commissioning, and focused regression coverage pins all five registered ROI commissioning entities. Alpha9.38 is presentation/reporting only: no financial arithmetic, simulation, optimiser allocation, tariff policy, battery policy, SOC arithmetic, commissioning authority, control eligibility or FoxESS command/write authority changes. Alpha9.37 repairs the customer-facing managed dashboard data contract exposed by Alpha9.36 live proof. Compare now consumes the same canonical current-day KEMS cost, grid-import and grid-export entities as the KEMS page instead of an older Full KEMS scenario replay, so daily costs and energy totals remain consistent across views. The ROI commissioning cards now reference their registered *_since_commissioning entities, the Live Data solar-today row uses canonical measured solar evidence already published on the current-day simulation state, and History uses the registered lifetime gas-consumption and net-energy-cost entities. Alpha9.37 is presentation/reporting only: no optimiser allocation, tariff policy, battery policy, SOC arithmetic, commissioning authority, control eligibility or FoxESS command/write authority changes. Alpha9.36 restores the commissioning-scoped ROI entities that Alpha9.35 added to the managed dashboard. The four financial energy sensors now publish with Home Assistant-valid TOTAL state classes, so Solar generated, Grid imported, Grid exported and House electricity since commissioning register correctly; Paid export income is consequently no longer skipped by the same registration sequence. TOTAL is deliberate rather than TOTAL_INCREASING because moving the selected Financial commissioning date can legitimately decrease or reset these scoped totals. Alpha9.36 is an entity-registration hotfix only: the Alpha9.35 financial-period arithmetic and post-commission ROI projection remain unchanged, and there are no optimiser, tariff, battery policy, commissioning authority or FoxESS command/write authority changes. Alpha9.35 makes every operational figure on the ROI page share the selected Financial commissioning date boundary. It adds a commissioning-scoped financial period for physical house consumption, solar generation, grid import, grid export and paid export income, exposes the Financial start date beside Financial operating days, and makes ROI projection evidence use only retained post-commission evidence rather than pre-live simulation. The underlying all-time lifetime ledger remains unchanged for learning and reporting outside ROI. Alpha9.35 is reporting and ROI-projection only: no optimiser allocation, tariff policy, battery policy, control authority or FoxESS command/write authority changes, and real hardware writes remain hard-blocked. Alpha9.34 makes physical battery installation an explicit persisted commissioning setting instead of inferring installation from FoxESS values. Battery installed defaults fail-closed to Off, so upgrades remain in the proven solar-only commissioning state until an operator explicitly confirms that a physical battery exists. FoxESS SOC, power, current and voltage remain telemetry-health evidence rather than installation authority: the current no-battery sentinel pattern is advisory while Battery installed is Off, but becomes a required telemetry fault when Battery installed is On; SOC 0 by itself remains valid when the rest of the telemetry is credible. The new Battery installed configuration switch publishes installation source, telemetry health and setting/telemetry mismatch evidence. Changing this setting cannot commission control, cannot grant command authority and cannot permit real FoxESS writes; full battery mapping, telemetry, direction, stability and all existing commissioning/control gates remain independently required, with real hardware writes hard-blocked. Alpha9.33 restores live ROI tracking and a first-class ROI view on the authoritative managed customer dashboard. The explicitly selected Financial commissioning date now rebuilds actual avoided-import value and actual system value from retained physical evidence from that date forward, so solar-only operation can begin real payback before battery/control commissioning. Only actual avoided-import value and genuine paid export income count toward actual ROI; simulated battery/export gains remain excluded. Financial commissioning remains separate from control commissioning, and Alpha9.33 makes no optimiser allocation, FoxESS command/write authority, battery policy, or control authority changes. Retain Alpha9.32 live actual export-income accounting so No paid export is always valued at 0p while measured export kWh is retained, Fixed export uses the configured fixed rate, and Agile Outgoing values each measured export interval at the published Region L half-hour price instead of the legacy 12p comparison benchmark. Missing Agile prices fail closed rather than silently substituting the benchmark, signed Agile prices are retained, and selecting No paid export performs an idempotent startup repair of false actual export income on only the latest retained live day and immediately previous day without changing physical export energy or simulated/what-if values. Alpha9.31 corrects FoxESS Modbus freshness semantics for unchanged live telemetry. KEMS now preserves each source's raw Home Assistant report age for diagnostics, but an old mapped FoxESS numeric source is accepted only when a fresh numeric foxess_modbus sibling on the identical Home Assistant device_id proves that the same inverter telemetry cohort is still live. The resulting effective cohort age feeds aggregate/control freshness, preventing a legitimate sustained zero grid-import reading from falsely tripping commissioning or Control Lab while retaining fail-closed behaviour when registry identity is absent, the fresh source belongs to another device, or the whole same-device cohort is stale. Alpha9.31 does not special-case zero and does not extend the 180-second freshness threshold. Retain Alpha9.30 live FoxESS KH7 load_power and grid_consumption authority and its read-only solar-only commissioning evidence stage while the battery installation is pending. Site PV, house, grid direction, raw units, stability and whole-site power balance can therefore be proven without pretending that battery SOC or battery direction exists; full commissioning and every real FoxESS write remain blocked until the battery and all control evidence are present. Alpha9.29 adds one extra gap to the V2 flow animation: four-position packet spacing leaves one dark row between packets so simultaneous import and export directions are easier to distinguish, while V1 remains unchanged. Alpha9.28 advances the managed panel to 0.9.0-alpha9-panel.2 with a V2-only staggered-flow animation. Each five-row V2 connector launches the next flow packet when the preceding head reaches the fourth position, while V1 keeps its established 2x4 flow timing unchanged. Alpha9.27 is a reporting-only policy-label publication cleanup. When the 15% planning/export target has been reached, deliberate export is zero and ordinary Home battery service continues toward the independent 10% absolute floor, final/current/shadow-facing action labels now report the canonical house-only bridge instead of historical 10% planning-target or reserve-floor wording. Alpha9.26 adds selectable managed-panel profiles without changing energy policy. V1 remains the default/current 16x16 layout for backwards compatibility. V2 adds the inverter-centred faceplate with Grid, Solar and the 90-degree counter-clockwise rotated ten-cell Battery flowing into the central Inverter, then Home and EV flowing out; the Inverter retains the existing slow colour fade. The selected profile is available in KEMS Settings and as a live Home Assistant select consumed by the managed ESP32 firmware. Retain Alpha9.25 reserve observability and reporting-only cheap-window charge capability: 100% remains a charging target, not a hard deadline, and KEMS charges as much as possible during confirmed cheap time. Retain the Alpha9.24 flow parity export-floor correction and its 15% planning/export target, independent 10% absolute floor for house/import protection and restart-safe 12% recovery latch. Retain the Alpha9.22 startup hotfix at build_slot_flow that prevents the unexpected planning_target_soc_percent keyword failure at the flow-contract boundary. Retain Alpha9.13 forecast-aware scheduling, Alpha9.19 runtime Recorder hygiene, Alpha9.20 ShadowValidationRecorder Recorder hygiene and all prior Alpha9 behaviour. No optimiser allocation, tariff, Happy Hour, Power Down, SOC arithmetic, panel or FoxESS command/write authority changes; Pi Web remains 0.9.0-alpha9-web.0, Public Web remains 0.9.0-alpha9-public.0 and Panel remains 0.9.0-alpha9-panel.3; configured KH7 limits remain 7.0 kW; real FoxESS hardware writes remain hard-blocked until physical commissioning is complete. Retain the Alpha9 coordinated parity baseline.
